conbody.p: SentinelGate is a fictional enterprise platform created for this portfolio project to demonstrate product, administrator, and API documentation for an AI-security product.
The gateway sits between an application and an AI provider. It applies configurable security policies, routes requests, and records security events for operational review.

section.title: Audience
section.p: This documentation is intended for application developers, platform administrators, product teams, and support engineers.
